text:
TAQAT AL-YAWN AL-A’MMAH
Tamtaddu amamaka yawm 13 Nufimbir (November) 2026 taqa’ jamila wa mustaqarrah tunasib tabi’ataka al-arḍiyyah ya burth al-Thawr. Tastati’u al-yawm an tush’ira bi-salam dakhili ‘ami yunazzimu afkaraka wa yaj’alaka akthar qudratan ‘ala muwajahati al-tahaddiyat bi-hudu’ wathiq. Al-jaww al-‘amm yahuththuka ‘ala al-thabat wa ‘adam al-ta’ajjul fi ayya qarar, fa-anta tamliku al-waqt al-kafi li-dirasati kulli khatwah bi-inaya. Ruhuki al-yawm maygala ila al-bina’ wa al-tastir al-tawil al-mada, mimma yamnahuka sha’wuran bil-itminan wa al-raha al-nafsiyyah al-‘amiqqah.

AL-‘ISHQ WA AL-‘ALAQAT
Lil-murtabitin, ya’ti hadha al-yawm li-yu’azziza al-rawabit al-‘atifiyyah baynaka wa bayn al-sharif ‘abr hiwarat dafi’a wa sadiqa tusahhihu al-masar. Innaha lahdhatun mumtazah li-tafkik ayy su’ tafahum sabiq wa binai jusur jadidah min al-thiqa wa al-mawaddah al-mutabadalah. Amma lil-‘uzzab, fa-qad tush’iru bi-raghbah qawiyyah fi al-infitah ‘ala wujuh jadidah wa qad yalfitu nazharaka shakhshun yushatiruka nafs al-qiyam wa al-nuzhur al-mustaqiryah lil-hayah. La tatajannah al-fursah lil-ta’arruf ‘ala man yumkinuhu an yudkhila al-daf’ ila qalbika bi-tariqah tabi’iyyah wa ghunaymah.

AL-‘AMR WA AL-CARIYAR
‘Ala su’ayd al-mal, yajibu ‘alayka al-yawm al-turkiz ‘ala al-maham al-mutawaqqafah wa inhauha bi-diqqatin shadidah allati tumayyuzuka ya thawr. Qad tazharu amamaka fursatun thaminatun li-ithbati kafa’atika amam al-mudarin aw zumala’ika fi al-‘amal, fala tudawwi’ha bi-al-taraddud. Unzuru ila al-tafasil al-duqqiqa fa-hiya allati satasna’u al-farq al-kabir fi naja’ika al-yawm wa tumayyuzuka ‘an al-akharin. Thiq bi-qudratika al-tanzimiyyah al-‘aliyyah wa la takhaf min tahammul mas’uliyyat jadidah satuzidu min rusuwika al-mihni.

AL-MAL WA AL-BARAKAH
Al-wad’ al-mali yatamattau bi-istiqrar malhus, wa huwa waqtun munasib jiddan li-muraja’ati mizaniyatika wa takhtiti mustaqbalika al-mali bi-hikmah. Qad tatalqha khabaran sayyiran yata’allaqu bi-izdihar mali qadim aw ziyadah mutawaqqa’ah fi al-dakhl tuthlij sadrka. ‘Ala al-raghm min hatha al-istiqrar, unsuhka bi-altizam al-ta’aqqul fi al-shira’ al-‘ashwa’i wa al-tarkiz ‘ala al-istithmarat al-dhakiyyah al-amnah. Al-barakah haliyyatun fi rizqika ma dumta tushakkiru al-ni’am wa tutsarru biha bi-i’tidal.

AL-SIHHA WA AL-TAQAH
Sihhatuka al-jasadiyyah wa al-nafsiyyah fi afdal ahwaliha, shart an tu’tiya nafsaka al-waqt al-lazim lil-raha wa al-istikhla’ ba’d al-juhd. Unsuhka bi-quda’ waqt fi al-tabi’ah aw mumarasati tamarin al-tamadhud (yoga) aw al-mashy fi al-hawa’ al-taliq li-tajdid taqatika al-hayawiyyah. Inna ‘ina’ataka bi-nizamika al-ridha’i wa shurb al-ma’ bi-kammiyyat kafiyah sayuzidani min nashatika wa yuhsinu min mawdayik al-nawmiyyah. Istami’ ila jasadika wa la tutaqqifhu akthar min taqatihi, fa al-rahah laysat kasalan bal huwa waqud lil-isti’naf.

AL-ITTISAL WA AL-MUJTAMA’
Tatamattau al-yawm bi-qudratin ‘aliyyah ‘ala al-tawasul al-fa’al ma’ al-muhitin bika min ‘a’ilah wa asdiqa’. Waqtuka al-makhsus ma’ al-ahbab sayajlubu al-sa’adah al-mutabadalah wa yuhallu ayy khilafat basita kanat tu’akkiru safw al-jaww al-usari. Asdiqaa’uka al-muqarrabun qad yalja’una ilayka lil-mashwarah aw al-da’m al-ma’nawi, wa dawruka huna sayakunu asasiyyan wa mu’aththiran bi-ijabiyyah. Kun munsiyan jayyidan wa manshan daf’ian li-man hawlaka, fa-wujuduka yumaththilu masdar amnin wa thibatin lil-jami’.

NANSIHAT AL-YAWM
Unzuru ila al-umur bi-anana wathiqah wa la taqlaq min al-bata’ fi al-injaz, fa al-khutuwat al-thabitah hiya allati tubni al-imbaraturiyyat al-qawiyyah.

TAFASIL AL-YAWM
Al-raqam al-hazizh: 6
Al-lawn al-hazizh: Al-akhdar al-zaytuni al-dafi’
Al-burj al-mutawafiq ma’ahu: Burj al-Jady
